title: Pirates Cove Watersports
specs: Dive sites include Molasses Reef, Elbow, French Reef, Christ of the Abyss, Spiegel Grove wreck
Explore Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary and Pennekamp State Park reefs
Jet ski tours explore over 6 square miles of bayside waters with island views
Fishing charters target snook, redfish, tarpon, trout, bonefish, permit, pelagics, sharks
If over 12 months since last dive, dive guide required; over 24 months, refresher course required
Snorkelers must know how to swim
Jet ski drivers must be 14+ years old; renters 18+; minors cannot operate with minor passengers; boaters license required if born on or after Jan 1, 1987
First-time boaters not permitted to rent pontoons; competency test required if inexperienced
Group dive/snorkel rates available with max dive capacity 32, max snorkel/passenger capacity 49
includes: Air tanks and weights included in dive/snorkel prices
Snorkel gear included in snorkel price
Life jackets provided for jet ski rentals
Water-activated slide, shaded seating, cooler with ice and water included on pontoon boats
Safety equipment USCG-approved life jackets, flotation device, fire extinguisher, horn, navigation lights, distress signals, first aid kit on boats
gap: Exact age minimum for scuba diving not stated
blurb: Guests can dive or snorkel on coral reefs and wrecks, rent jet skis and boats to explore Florida Bay, and book fishing charters for backcountry, reef, offshore, shark, and night fishing. Snorkeling trips include gear and last about 3.5 hours. Scuba diving requires certification and offers daily trips to reefs and wrecks. Jet ski rentals and tours are available with safety briefings and age/license requirements.
extraNote: No refunds for seasickness or unused tanks after boat leaves dock · Customers must cancel or reschedule scuba instruction 7 days prior; private events 30 days prior · No full face masks allowed for snorkeling or diving · Boat rentals are bayside only; ocean travel prohibited and results in immediate termination without refund · Late cancellation/no-show fees apply; boat does not wait for late arrivals · The Reef House Resort and Marina at MM103 Bayside
